You are the Northwind Outdoor support assistant. Northwind Outdoor sells bikes and camping gear.

You receive (a) the customer's ticket and (b) the handbook excerpts retrieved for this ticket. Answer only from those excerpts.

Required-fact completeness. Before you write the reply, list every fact the ticket needs answered (fee amounts, deadlines, eligibility conditions, point rates, retention periods, caps, and similar concrete values). Then verify each one is present in the excerpts. Include every fact you find, with the exact value as written (e.g. "$15.00 Express upgrade fee", "within 48 hours", "5 points per $1.00"). If the ticket asks for more than one piece of information, cover them all.

Citation discipline. Cite each claim with the section id shown in the heading of the excerpt you used, e.g. [returns]. You may only cite section ids whose heading text is present in the excerpts above you. Never cite a id that is not visible (including numbered variants such as `<id>.1`). Never assert a policy detail that is not literally in the excerpts. If a needed fact is absent from the excerpts, do not fill it in — say which specific fact the excerpts do not contain and offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

Do not hedge the facts. If the excerpts contain the fact, state it plainly; do not soften exact values, and do not add caveats the excerpts do not contain. Do not say "the handbook does not provide X" as a substitute for the value — either you include the value or you flag the gap explicitly and offer escalation.

Be direct and concise. Do not ask clarifying questions the ticket already answers from the excerpts.

Handbook excerpts:
# Damaged Items

1. You must report any visible damage to your Northwind Outdoor order within 48 hours of delivery. To initiate a claim, log into your account and select the "Report Damage" option. You are required to upload at least 3 high-resolution photos showing the specific defect, the overall item, and the shipping packaging. Failure to provide this visual evidence within the 48-hour window will result in an automatic denial of the claim, as we cannot verify the condition of the item after it has been used or stored.

2. If the damage is minor, such as a small scratch on a bike frame or a loose stitching on a tent fly, we will offer a 15% discount on your next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and is valid for 30 days. For major structural failures, such as a cracked wheel rim or a torn tent pole, we will issue a full refund of the item’s price, up to a maximum of $500.00 per item. Items exceeding this value require a manual review by our senior support team, which may take up to 5 business days to process.

3. When we approve a full refund or replacement, you must ship the damaged item back to our warehouse within 10 days of receiving the return authorization label. We will provide a prepaid shipping label for items under 20 lbs. For heavier items, such as mountain bikes or large camping stoves, you must arrange your own freight pickup. We will reimburse up to 50% of the shipping cost, capped at $75.00, provided you submit the original receipt within 14 days of the pickup date.

4. If the damage is caused by improper use, such as overloading a bike rack beyond its 150 lb capacity limit or using a camping stove in a non-ventilated area, the claim will be denied. We reserve the right to inspect the item upon return. If our inspection reveals signs of misuse or neglect, we will notify you within 3 business days. In such cases, you will be responsible for the return shipping costs, which typically range from $15.00 to $40.00 depending on the item’s weight and dimensions.

5. For items that are partially damaged but still functional, we may offer a repair service at no cost to you. This includes replacing broken zippers on backpacks or fixing bent handlebars on bikes. The repair process takes approximately 7 to 10 business days. During this time, you may request a loaner item if available, subject to a $20.00 deposit that is refunded upon the return of the loaner in good condition.

## Key facts

- You have 48 hours to report damage with 3 photos.
- Minor damage earns a 15% discount valid for 30 days.
- Full refunds are capped at $500.00 per item.
- You must return damaged items within 10 days.
- Misuse claims are denied, and you pay return shipping.

# Returns

1. You have a strict 30-day window from the date of delivery to initiate a return request. If you miss this deadline, we cannot accept the item back, and no refund will be issued. This period is non-negotiable to ensure fair inventory management for our warehouse staff.
2. All returned items must be in their original, unused condition with all tags, manuals, and protective packaging intact. If the item shows signs of wear, dirt, or damage, we will deduct a 15% restocking fee from your refund amount. This fee covers the labor required to inspect and repackage the goods for resale.
3. Standard ground shipping costs for returns are the customer’s responsibility. We offer a prepaid return label for a flat fee of $12.50. If you choose to ship via an expedited carrier, you must pay the full shipping cost upfront, and we will only reimburse the standard rate upon receipt of the item.
4. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after we receive and inspect your package. The funds will appear in your original payment method within an additional 3 to 7 business days, depending on your bank’s processing times. Please note that credit card issuers may take up to 10 days to post the credit.
5. High-value items, specifically those priced over $500, require a signature upon delivery. If you are not present to sign for the package, the carrier will leave a notice. You have 48 hours to retrieve the item from the local depot. If you fail to collect it within this timeframe, the item is considered returned, and the return process begins immediately.
6. We do not accept returns on custom-configured bikes or personalized gear. These items are made to order and cannot be resold. If you ordered the wrong size or color, you are responsible for the full cost of the item, which is non-refundable. Please double-check your specifications before confirming your order.

## Key facts

- The return window is exactly 30 days from the delivery date.
- A 15% restocking fee applies if the item is not in perfect, unused condition.
- The prepaid return label costs a flat fee of $12.50.
- Refunds are processed within 5 business days of receiving the package.
- Items priced over $500 require a signature and must be collected within 48 hours if missed.

Customer question:
I am standing in the rain right now, completely stuck, and I need immediate help. I just picked up my new bike, but the rear brake cable is snapped. I can’t ride this to work, and I’m not waiting around for a standard response. I need to know if I can return this defective unit today. I know the policy states I have 30 days from delivery to request a return, but I am at day one and this is an emergency. I need a replacement or a full refund processed immediately so I can get back on the road. Also, please confirm my shipping status. My order total was $185.00, which is well over the $150.00 threshold for free international shipping. I should not be seeing any extra charges on my final invoice. I am running out of time and patience. Please prioritize this ticket. I need a solution before I leave this location. Do not send me a generic email. Call me or send a direct chat message. I am blocked and this is urgent. I need to know exactly what steps to take right now to resolve this brake issue and ensure my shipping costs are correct. I am ready to act immediately if you give me the green light. Please respond within the next five minutes. I am waiting by the phone. This is not a drill. I need to get home and fix this situation before my next meeting. Thank you for your prompt attention to this critical matter. I am counting on your quick response to unblock my day.

response:
**Required-fact completeness check:**
1.  **Damage reporting deadline:** 48 hours from delivery [Damaged Items].
2.  **Damage reporting method:** Log into account, select "Report Damage," upload at least 3 high-resolution photos (defect, overall item, packaging) [Damaged Items].
3.  **Consequence of missing deadline:** Automatic denial [Damaged Items].
4.  **Remedy for minor damage (snapped cable):** 15% discount on next purchase, valid for 30 days [Damaged Items].
5.  **Remedy for major structural failure:** Full refund up to $500.00 per item [Damaged Items].
6.  **Repair option:** Free repair service for functional items (e.g., bent handlebars), takes 7–10 business days [Damaged Items].
7.  **Return shipping for approved refund/replacement:** Ship back within 10 days of authorization; prepaid label for items under 20 lbs [Damaged Items].
8.  **Free international shipping threshold:** **Not present in excerpts.** The excerpts do not contain a policy regarding a "$150.00 threshold for free international shipping" or any international shipping fees.
9.  **Contact method (Call/Chat):** **Not present in excerpts.** The excerpts do not contain instructions for requesting a phone call or direct chat, nor do they confirm if this is possible.

**Response:**

You must report the snapped rear brake cable within 48 hours of delivery to avoid automatic denial of the claim [Damaged Items]. To initiate the claim, log into your account, select "Report Damage," and upload at least 3 high-resolution photos showing the specific defect, the overall item, and the shipping packaging [Damaged Items].

Regarding the remedy:
*   If the snapped cable is classified as **minor damage**, you will receive a 15% discount on your next purchase, which is valid for 30 days [Damaged Items].
*   If it is classified as a **major structural failure**, you will receive a full refund of the item’s price, up to a maximum of $500.00 per item [Damaged Items].
*   Alternatively, if the bike is still functional, we may offer a **free repair service**, which takes approximately 7 to 10 business days [Damaged Items].

If a full refund or replacement is approved, you must ship the damaged item back to our warehouse within 10 days of receiving the return authorization label [Damaged Items]. We will provide a prepaid shipping label for items under 20 lbs [Damaged Items].

**Missing Information:**
The provided handbook excerpts do not contain information regarding a "$150.00 threshold for free international shipping" or any international shipping fee policies. Additionally, the excerpts do not contain instructions for requesting a phone call or direct chat message. I cannot confirm your shipping status or guarantee a specific contact method based on the available text.

I recommend escalating this ticket to a human agent to address the international shipping fee discrepancy and to request the immediate contact method you require.
